business_problem: VGZ needed to replace a limiting cloud data warehouse with a more scalable and governed platform so it could deliver new data products faster without increasing maintenance effort on sensitive healthcare workloads.
solution_summary: VGZ uses Databricks Data + AI Platform, Databricks SQL, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog to support health insurance data platform modernization. VGZ needed to replace a limiting cloud data warehouse with a more scalable and governed platform so it could deliver new data products faster without increasing maintenance effort on sensitive healthcare workloads. In practice, the implementation stores or organizes core datasets in Delta Lake, governs access and lineage with Unity Catalog, runs transformation or AI logic on Databricks Data + AI Platform, and delivers outputs through Databricks SQL. Legacy operational and analytics data are consolidated into Delta Lake; Databricks Data + AI Platform applies analytics or model logic; results are surfaced through Databricks SQL. The case study reports Delivering on the vision for better patient care 30%, Faster time to market for new data products 50%, and 30%, showing measurable improvement after the rollout.
business_outcome: VGZ reported Delivering on the vision for better patient care 30%, Faster time to market for new data products 50%, and 30%, improving health insurance data platform modernization with measurable gains in productivity improvement, speed to market, and scalability.
